subject: maths
question: By selling a computer for Rs. 26,000, a man gains 4%. If he sells the computer for Rs. 19,000, then his loss will be:
solution:
Given:

Selling price = Rs. 26,000,

Gain = 4%,

New selling price = Rs. 19,000

Concept:

Cost price = Selling price/(1 + Gain),

Loss = (Cost price - New selling price)/Cost price

Solution:

⇒ Cost price = 26000/(1 + 0.04) = Rs. 25000

⇒ Loss = (25000 - 19000)/25000

⇒ Loss = 0.24 or 24%

Therefore, his loss will be 24%.
